prompt:
Educational flat-design concept map — mind map illustration, square 1:1 format. Italian middle school textbook (scuola secondaria I grado), DigComp I level. Central hub: large rounded rectangle "💻 Dati, privacy e identità digitale", solid fill #006064, white bold sans-serif label, subtle drop shadow. Five branch clusters radiate from the hub with smooth curved lines. Each branch has a colored pill label and 2–5 smaller rounded child nodes:
  • INNESCA [#5E35B1]: "Dati, privacy e identità digitale"
  • ESPLORA [#1565C0]: "Lo studente gestisce consapevolmente la propria…" | "GDPR" | "studente" | "comprende"
  • SPERIMENTA [#E65100]: "dato personale / personal data" | "GDPR / GDPR (General Data Protection Regulation)"
  • AGISCI [#00695C]: "Mappa la tua impronta digitale in una settimana" | "elenca tutti i servizi/app che hai usato, che…" | "Professione futura: Cybersecurity Analyst"
  • RIPASSA [#F57F17]: "privacy" | "GDPR" | "dati personali" | "identità digitale" | "dato personale"
Style rules: white background, all labels in Italian, branch nodes solid fill (branch color) with white text, hub accent stripe #006064 on bottom edge only, connecting lines 2px curved matching branch color, no photographs, no decorative frames, no gradients, clean radial balanced layout, Inter/Nunito-style sans-serif typography, WCAG AA contrast, flat vector illustration, 1:1 square.
